hypothesis.counterevidence: The corpus is answer-free: artifact and trace content are hashes only, so the exact failing property cannot be read. The module storing VOL_SCALING_TARGET=5.34 does not by itself prove misuse (code may divide by 100 at use, which AST facts cannot show). The 1-failure-per-family fingerprint is equally consistent with h2 (temporal-lag endpoint), which the evidence cannot exclude. T16's success shows the harness can pass without any validator, so the tool is an improvement, not a demonstrated necessity. Five earlier prompt-only mutations produced no gain or regressions.
hypothesis.discriminating_probe: probe t24_scale_anchor_vs_t16: T24 module has exactly one numeric constant, value 5.34 (raw percent anchor); T16 module has zero; paper quotes only '5.34% per month'. probe prior_attempt_role_mismatch: entry activation.status=failed with reason 'declared component file roles differ', component_roles=[agent_config, systemprompt, tool_descriptions, tools] vs declared_roles including validator, all component_tests passed, official_worker_evaluation_run=false - the mechanism was never evaluated.
hypotheses_considered: h1_unit_scale: T24's submitted strategy.py stores the paper's volatility-scaling target as its ONLY module numeric constant, VOL_SCALING_TARGET = 5.34 (raw percent form); paper_text.md quotes the anchor only as '5.34% per month' and never as 0.0534; applied without /100 to decimal market-return data, portfolio_weight/strategy_return are ~100x too large, failing scale-sensitive properties. Fingerprint: exactly 1 failed property per family (type_a 6/7, type_b 9/10); the successful T16 module (18/18 pass) has NO module numeric constants.

h2_temporal_lag: T24 instruction R2/R4 mandate a strictly-causal expanding_mean endpoint (exclude current month), strictly-prior newsy months in sum_4_newsy, and a mandatory shift(1) lag on portfolio_weight/strategy_return; a wrong endpoint misaligns strategy_return with returns and fails lag/NaN-placement properties; 1-failure-per-family fingerprint is also consistent with this.

hypothesis.selected_mechanism: Deterministic pre-submission validator (tools/strategy_validate.py, registered as validate_strategy_module) that audits interface compliance, synthetic runnability, output-column completeness under an explicit augment contract, all-NaN/trailing-NaN lag placement, look-ahead shift(-1), percent-form module constants used without /100 conversion, and output/input magnitude ratio >100x; addresses both h1 and h2 without encoding any task answer.
hypothesis.uncertainty: Cannot confirm the precise failing property or that 5.34 is applied unconverted. The prior executable attempt of this same mechanism (history entry 926ce...) was rejected solely on a component-role declaration mismatch (declared 'validator' with no validator/ file changed) and was never worker-evaluated; this ACT repairs that declaration (no phantom validator role) and improves the tool's checks.
